{{Quote|I'm Senior Field Agent Suria. I understand you've done extensive work with the SIS.|Suria|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Agent Suria''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who worked for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Holding the rank of Field Agent, she was stationed on [[Quesh]] in [[3642 BBY]] where she tasked a fellow Republic citizen with checking on her subordinate Agent [[Meldo]], who missed two scheduled comm checks.
